summary: Compares the Ansible community package with ansible-core: versioning, semantic versioning, number of maintained versions, contents, and where each is developed.
questions: What is the difference between the ansible package and ansible-core?
Should I install ansible or ansible-core?
How many ansible-core versions are maintained at once?

answer_card.title: Ansible community package vs ansible-core
answer_card.answer_md:
| | Ansible community package | ansible-core |
|---|---|---|
| Versioning | 2.10, then 3.0.0+ | classic 2.11, 2.12... |
| SemVer | Yes | No |
| Maintained | One version at a time | Latest + two older |
| Contents | Language, runtime and 85+ selected collections | Language, runtime and builtin plugins |
| Developed in | Collection repos | ansible/ansible |

Most users install the community package. Choose `ansible-core` if you want to install only the collections you need.
